purpose: Public-safe per-row evidence ledger for Google-owned and owner-owned monetization checks. A row-level PASS means that specific evidence item passed; it does not mean full AdMob production monetization is ready unless the strict pass command passes.

items.ownerAction: Re-run the public root check after every deploy, publisher change, or developer website change.
